model.name: detailView.assertNoBespokeDuplication
model.description: R40.5's DEDUP-ENFORCEMENT facet (distinct from the migrate-extra-buttons UC): a scoped CI lint over the detail/feature VIEW surfaces (rb-*detail*.ts, EXCLUDING editor chrome rb-editor-toolbar/layout) asserts NO logical action button is implemented BESPOKE in >1 view — a duplicate across >=2 views must be ONE universalActionBar action unit. Single-surface chrome is legitimate + PASSES. FAILS (exit 1) on any cross-file duplicate; stub-must-fail (plant the same button in a 2nd view -> RED). This is R40.5's OWN distinct-intent coverage, NOT the shared universalActionBar migration.
